title: Optimizing check for PA eligibility
summary: The Payables Agent eligibility check now uses a more efficient query strategy to avoid unnecessary slowdowns when opening the Purchase Invoice page by leveraging an existing database index on Posting Date instead of relying on systemCreatedAt.
key_points: A new query checks Payables Agent eligibility using Posting Date instead of systemCreatedAt
Uses the existing BaseApp key on Posting Date, then iterates the results to match the user ID
Limits how many records are loaded from SQL so the check stays time-bounded
Speeds up opening the Purchase Invoice page and the agent runtime eligibility check
The heuristic is less accurate, so the set of eligible users may differ slightly
